metadata.title: Yakthung Pan Sirijonga Curriculum
metadata.description: Complete Sirijonga script, Kubung-sak pure vowels, Saknam-sak matras, Chuk-sak final consonants, Ektum conjuncts, Kusek marks, and Khanin numerals aligned with Phedape Limbu dialect conventions.

saknamLevel14Items.ruleDesc: Amma attaches to the right of any consonant to produce the long "aa" sound.
Iksu sits above the letter to produce the crisp "i" vowel.
Uksu loops underneath the stem to produce the "u" vowel sound.
First syllable of the sacred Phedape greeting "Sewaro" (ᤛᤣᤘᤠᤖᤥ).
Ainu adds the double-stroke diphthong mark for the "ai" sound.
Final syllable of "Sewaro" (ᤛᤣᤘᤠᤖᤥ) creating the rich "o" vowel.
Tumbo creates the rounded diphthong "au" sound.
Authentic Limbu open vowel "ae" mark distinctive to Yakthung Pan.

chukLevel15Items.ruleDesc: In Sirijonga script, full letter ᤁ becomes half letter ᤰ (चुक्-साक्). Example: ᤕ (Ya) + ᤰ (-k) = ᤕᤰ (Yak in Yakthung). Book font key: Z = ट.
In Sirijonga script, full letter ᤅ becomes half letter ᤱ (चुक्-साक्). Example: ᤌᤢ (Thu) + ᤱ (-ng) = ᤌᤢᤱ (Thung). Book font key: उ° = ०.
In Sirijonga script, full letter ᤋ becomes half letter ᤳ (चुक्-साक्). Example: ᤏᤣ (Ne) + ᤳ (-t) = ᤏᤣᤳ (Net = 2). Book font key: ३ = ⌒.
In Sirijonga script, full letter ᤐ becomes half letter ᤵ (चुक्-साक्). Example: ᤌᤡ (Thi) + ᤵ (-p) = ᤌᤡᤵ (Thip = 0). Book font key: w = ч.
In Sirijonga script, full letter ᤔ becomes half letter ᤶ (चुक्-साक्). Example: ᤁᤠ (Kaa) + ᤶ (-m) = ᤁᤠᤶ (Kam = Friend). Book font key: य = ५.
In Sirijonga script, full letter ᤖ becomes half letter ᤷ (चुक्-साक्). Example: ᤛ (Sa) + ᤷ (-r) = ᤛᤷ (Sar). Book font key: र = ,.
In Sirijonga script, full letter ᤗ becomes half letter ᤸ (चुक्-साक्). Example: ᤌᤢ (Thu) + ᤸ (-l) = ᤌᤢᤸ (Thul). Book font key: u = प.

chukLevel13_1Items.instruction: Identify the Subjoined Final -k attached to Ka: ᤁᤰ
chukLevel13_1Items.ruleDesc: Attaches to consonant as terminal -k (e.g., 'Yak' ᤕᤰ in Yakthung). Sirijonga font key: Z = ट / ᤰ.

chukLevel13_1Items.instruction: Identify the Subjoined Final -ng attached to Ka: ᤁᤱ
chukLevel13_1Items.ruleDesc: Attaches above consonant as terminal -ng nasal dot (e.g., 'Thung' ᤌᤢᤱ in Yakthung). Sirijonga font key: उ° = ० / ᤱ.

chukLevel13_1Items.instruction: Identify the Subjoined Final -t attached to Ka: ᤁᤳ
chukLevel13_1Items.ruleDesc: Attaches below consonant as bottom curve terminal -t (e.g., 'Net' ᤏᤣᤳ = Two). Sirijonga font key: ३ = ⌒ / ᤳ.

chukLevel13_1Items.instruction: Identify the Subjoined Final -p attached to Ka: ᤁᤵ
chukLevel13_1Items.ruleDesc: Attaches under the letter as terminal -p (e.g., 'Thip' ᤌᤡᤵ = Zero). Sirijonga font key: w = ч / ᤵ.

chukLevel13_1Items.instruction: Identify the Subjoined Final -m attached to Ka: ᤁᤶ
chukLevel13_1Items.ruleDesc: Attaches under the letter as terminal -m (e.g., 'Kam' ᤁᤠᤶ = Friend). Sirijonga font key: य = ५ / ᤶ.

chukLevel13_1Items.instruction: Identify the Subjoined Final -r attached to Ka: ᤁᤷ
chukLevel13_1Items.ruleDesc: Attaches under the stem as terminal -r in authentic Phedape pronunciation. Sirijonga font key: र = , / ᤷ.

chukLevel13_1Items.instruction: Identify the Subjoined Final -l attached to Ka: ᤁᤸ
chukLevel13_1Items.ruleDesc: Attaches to the bottom-right as terminal liquid consonant -l. Sirijonga font key: य = u / ᤸ.

marksLevel13_2Items.ruleDesc: Subjoined -ya cluster (e.g., Kya / Chya). Used in 'Chyabrung' (ᤆᤩᤠᤒᤪᤢᤱ).
Subjoined -ra cluster (e.g., Kra / Pra). Used in 'Chyabrung' (ᤆᤩᤠᤒᤪᤢᤱ).
Subjoined -wa cluster (e.g., Kwa / Chwa). Forms labialized consonant blends.

marksLevel13_2Items.instruction: Identify Glottal Stop Sound Mark: Muphreng (᤹)
marksLevel13_2Items.ruleDesc: Glottal stop / abrupt check sound. Characteristic abrupt syllable cutoff in Limbu.
Vowel lengthening / sustained tone mark in spoken Yakthung Pan phonology.

marksLevel13_2Items.instruction: Identify Halanta Pure Consonant Mark: Sa-i (᤻)
marksLevel13_2Items.ruleDesc: Halanta / pure consonant killer mark that eliminates the default inherent 'a' vowel.
